up: For the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4651341', retrieve all compounds that are associated with this document (i.e., have a record in compound_records linked to that document). For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures). Sort the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Ensure that only compounds directly reported in the specified document are included. Do not apply any additional filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4651341' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
